ACT XIV of 2010
ACT XIV of 2010
SOCIETIES REGISTRATION (BALOCHISTAN
AMENDMENT) ACT, 2010
An Act further to amend the
Societies Registration
Act,1860, (Act No. XXI of 1860), in its application
to the Province of Balochistan
[Gazette of,Balochistan Extraordinary
1st November 2010]
No.
PAB/Legis:V(15)/2010; 661, dated 25-10-2010.---The Societies Registration
(Balochistan Amendment) Bill No.15 of 2010 having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of Balochistan on 15th
October, 2010 and
assented to by the Governor, Balochistan on 22nd October, 2010 is hereby
published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan.
Preamble.---Whereas Is expedient further to amend the Societies Registration Act, 1860 (X.XI of
1860), to the extent of the Province of Balochistan, the marines hereinafter
appearing.
It is hereby
enacted as follows:
1. Short title
and commencement.---(1) This Act
may be called the Societies Registration (Balochistan Amendment) Act, 2010.
(2) It shall come
into force at once and shall he deemed to have taken effect from the 29th
October, 2009.

Amendment of section 21, Act XXI of 1860

published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan.
Preamble.---Whereas Is expedient further to amend the Societies Registration Act, 1860 (X.XI of
1860), to the extent of the Province of Balochistan, the marines hereinafter
appearing.
It is hereby
enacted as follows:
2. Amendment of
section 21, Act XXI of 1860.---In
the Societies Registration Act, 1860 (Act No XXI of 1860)
hereinafter referred to as the said Act, for section 21, the following shall be
substituted namely:-
"21. Rstratior
of Deeni Mad;dris.--(1) All Deeni Madaris by whatsoever name called shall not
operate without getting themselves registered as under, namely:
(i) the Deeni
Madaris existing before the commencement of the Societies Registration
(Balochistan Amendment) Ordinance, 2007 if not already registered, shall get
themselves registered, under this Act and
(ii) the Deeni
Madaris which are established after the commencement of the Societies
Registration (Balochistan amendment) Ordinance, 2007 (XIX of 2007), shall get
themselves registered within one year of their establishment .
Explanation. --One Deeni Madarassah having
more than one campus shall need only one d;
gistration, however the details and the
places at which they function, ,hall have to be formed as part of the
registration.
(2) Every Deeni
Madrassah shall submit annual report
of its educational activities to the Registrar of Societies at the end of each
fiscal year.
(3) Every Deeni
Madrassah shall cause to carry out audit of its accounts by an authorised
Auditor and submit a copy of its audit report to the Registrar along with its
annual report,
(4) No Deeni
Madarassah shall teach or publish any literature which promotes militancy or
spreads sectarianism or religious hatred:
Provided that
nothing contained herein shall bar the comparative study of various religions
or school of thought or study of any other subject covered by the Holy Quran,
Sunnah or Islamic jurisprudence.
Explanation.---In this section "Deeni Madarassah"
means a religious institution primarily for religious education and includes
Jamia, Dar-ul-Uloom, School, College or University or called by any other name,
set up for purposes of primarily imparting religious education and providing
boarding and lodging facilities.

Repeal
